verdict.rationale: Mem0's official MCP server gives agents memory tools so they can decide for themselves when to save, look up, or update memories. The official CLI, positioned for both humans and AI agents, supports add, search, list, update, and delete. The search API is explicitly agent-facing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that delete is exposed as an MCP tool or API call rather than only via the CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents managing memory mid-conversation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can manage its own memory mid-conversation — adding, searching, updating, and deleting memories through tools or API calls it invokes itself

citations.quote: The Mem0 MCP server hands your agent a set of memory tools, so it can decide for itself when to save something, look something up, or update what it already knows.
The mem0 CLI lets you add, search, list, update, and delete memories directly from the terminal.
Manage memories from your terminal, for both humans and AI agents.
Mem0's search operation lets agents ask natural-language questions and get back the memories that matter most.
